# 1.37.0-beta.5

Fifth beta of 1.37.0: interface. New ways to reach things quickly and a lighter, darker look for every panel that pops up.

## Command palette

- Ctrl+Shift+P opens one search over actions, settings, recipes, slash commands and chats. Settings are found by the name you see on their row, and choosing one opens its page and subpage right at that row. Actions show their shortcut, and an empty search offers actions and your recent chats.

## Quick question

- Win+Shift+Q opens a small window over any app. Ask, read the answer right there and copy it, or press Open in chat to continue in the app with all its tools. A quick question that you never open in chat is not saved anywhere. The shortcut can be changed in Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts, under From any app.

## GlueGray theme

- A new dark theme, a little deeper than Carbon: cool, calm graphite greys like Carbon with a light accent, never pure black.

## A lighter interface

- Dialogs, confirmations, tooltips and the new panels sit on a darker surface of their own in every theme, with tighter spacing and smaller buttons.
- The question before a risky action is shorter: who asks sits next to the title, the parts of a PowerShell script that change the system are shown as tags, the script is one code block with only a copy button, and the dry run and details fold away.
- PC health opens as a panel under its button instead of covering the window. Live CPU, memory and system drive usage sit on top while it is open, and every area shows its status in one line with the details right under it.
- The journal is more compact: tabs next to the title, search and scope in one row, and every entry on a single line with a drawn status icon.
- What's new has its own card: the notes read straight in it, with the version as a tag next to the title. The notes before installing an update look the same.
- The balance, context and answer cost tooltips are small tables: numbers line up on the right, and explanations are dimmed underneath. The context tooltip gives exact used and free tokens, and the answer cost no longer explains how it is calculated.
- Folders in the sidebar are as tall as a chat row, with a quiet outline instead of a bright card.
